summary: "Firefox tightened up the core media pipeline around MediaStream, MediaRecorder, AudioWorklet, and picture-in-picture, fixing race conditions, invalid buffer sizes, and edge-case state handling in audio/video tracks. It also makes live-stream media behave as controllable media more consistently and keeps video PiP sizing correct under browser privacy protections. The result is smoother recording, better WebRTC call quality, and fewer glitches in streaming and audio-processing features."
